question: How is the indivisible supreme lord ritually bathed through direct touch by hand?
premises: He is ritually bathed at some time.
The bathing involves direct touch with the hand.
inference: Even the indivisible supreme lord is ritually bathed through direct contact made by hand.
uncertainties: abhedyā may qualify the manner or the devotee's attitude.
plain_english: At any time, bathing that indivisible supreme lord, he touches him with his hand.
